texts: Changed the Roadmap in the Timers and Roadmap page.
Made Community Assets searching less strict.
Fixed Synergies being marked as Threadspin 1 instead of 4.
Added weaknesses to the options on the Team Stat Distribution Panel in builds.
Closed the popularity poll page and moved it to the archive.
Added Discord integration for notifications. You can find this in the Edit Profile page.

body.text: The following are changes for the Idle Sim:

texts: Added sprites to agents. All agents default to the standard Hooligan. More sprites are unlocked through expedition progression.
Made slight improvements to the hiring menu.
Added a notification dot on Expeditions when there is a finished expedition.
Removed the check that prevents allocating stat points on agents currently in expeditions.
Changed the 'Recommended Agents' label on expeditions to 'Recommended Min Agents'.
